title: crataegus laevigata var. vulgaris
intro: Crataegus laevigata var. vulgaris, commonly known as English hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to support cardiovascular health by lowering blood pressure and improving lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of English hawthorn include acting as a vasodilator, improving cardiac function, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids (such as quercetin, rutin, and hyperoside), oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits.
